revision.comment: we don't use tildes like this, except on MySpace
Added picsize. Fixed bug for my2 where it used to show in multi-column.
Fixed bug. There is no order2.
Fixed romaji to make it permanently unhide. Fixed hantu bug which originally required other vietnamese parameters to be called first.
Fixed display order according to [[Wikipedia talk:Manual of Style (China-related articles)]] with mandarin block first. Fixed Korean revised roman multi-line display
Moved shanghainese under wu, Moved teochew and poj under Min as per [[Wikipedia talk:Manual of Style (China-related articles)]]
Added all 7 major show flags. List hidden dialects by alphabetical order by dialect name. Added hsn for Xiang, wuu for Wu, gan for Gan.
restore; need to test more colors but don't want to waste bandwidth
Reordered to not use "Yue" and "Guan" according to [[Wikipedia talk:Manual of Style (China-related articles)]]
changed "mandarin pinyin" to "hanyu pinyin" - it is the standard used for Chinese and default for non-Mandarin terms too.
Left "yue" in the hide box. Removed "yue" from unhide area since it takes up 2 lines and does not fit.
Expanded to lang11. Added Taishan under cantonese with "toi" and "toi2".
Mandarin label was fixed earlier at the top. Should fix bottom too.
If there is no Guan, then keija or hakka comes before "M" in alphabetical order
Apparently the shanghainese page has moved
added Royal Thai General System of Transcription
